title: HeadShape
description: A single head shape master data entry, parsed into HeadShape (lib/domain/master_data/head_shape.dart). One file per head shape, under assets/data/head_shapes/.

id.description: Stable identifier referenced by other data and code, and looked up in the app's localization resources for display text.

abnormalityResistanceBonuses.description: Maps an abnormality id (see abnormality_types.json) to the resistance bonus this head shape grants.

attributeResistanceBonuses.description: Maps an attribute id (see attributes.json) to the resistance bonus this head shape grants.
